summary: Sayyidah Zaynab, also called Set Zaynab, is a town in Syria's Rif Dimashq Governorate, south of Damascus. The note gives its 2004 census population of 136,427, which makes it Syria's 10th most populous city and the most populous satellite city of Damascus. It is administered within Markaz Rif Dimashq district and the Babbila subdistrict, and its municipality is still treated as a rural community by the governorate.
one_line: Sayyidah Zaynab is a town south of Damascus, Syria, noted as the country's 10th most populous city and Damascus's largest satellite city.
key_facts: Sayyidah Zaynab, commonly known as Set Zaynab, is a town in the Rif Dimashq Governorate of Syria.
Sayyidah Zaynab is located south of Damascus, the national capital of Syria.
The name Sayyidah Zaynab means "Lady Zaynab".
Sayyidah Zaynab had a population of 136,427 at the 2004 census.
Sayyidah Zaynab is the 10th most populous city in Syria.
Sayyidah Zaynab is the most populous satellite city of Damascus.
Administratively, Sayyidah Zaynab is located in Markaz Rif Dimashq district.
Sayyidah Zaynab belongs to the nahiyah (subdistrict) of Babbila.
The municipality of Sayyidah Zaynab is still considered a rural community by the governorate of Rif Dimashq.
